scope: Two distinct positive integer count tables over physical site type × photoperiod branch × six fixed solar-phase bins with identical every one-way and two-way margin but different within-site branch×phase interaction
frozen_checks: Both 2x2x6 integer arrays strictly positive and different
World A has strictly constant falling/rising ratio within each site across all six bins: early 3, late 1/3
World B has nonconstant falling/rising rate ratios within both sites
Every two-way count margin (site × branch, site × phase, branch × phase) exactly identical
Every one-way count margin and grand total exactly identical
With independent Poisson cells, aggregated branch × phase count array has the exact same full probability law in both worlds
Independent Poisson cell full-resolution Kullback-Leibler D(A||B) strictly positive
Linear two-way marginalization operator on 2×2×6 has rank 19 and nullity 5 = (2−1)(2−1)(6−1)
Explicit perturbation vector belongs to the nullspace with no floating tolerance
Different underlying three-way interaction need not be identifiable from published 2D count-margin summaries
Do not claim joint statistical probability law of ALL three overlapping two-way margins is identical under independent Poisson sampling
required_observed_grain: physical station × exact date pair × rising/falling season × solar-phase bin, including zero-detection cells from independently logged camera uptime
reporting: No Monte Carlo, no fitted p-values; exact arrays, all margins, rank/nullity, analytic Poisson aggregated equivalence, resolved-cell KL, conceptual release requirement
